modalLead: Config → Overview names the version you run and says when a newer one is out, a widget moves to another page from its settings, and a long round of fixes.

items.text: A Version panel on the overview. It names the release you run, with links to the changelog and the manual. A green dot means you have the newest release; a red one names the newer release, with a link to it.

A failed update check says why. The Version panel and the What's new bar name GitHub's hourly limit with the time of the next try, or say that GitHub could not be reached. A GitHub token under Config → Containers → Updates now counts for this check too.
Choose the pages Fresh shows on, under Structure → Collections → Collection scope, the same way as Today, Recent and Stale.
The section list on the left no longer slides under the header when you scroll a long section.
The line under the tabs follows the tab you open in Data & backups, Bookmarks and Help.
Move a widget from its settings. Config → Widgets → Settings has a Page choice; pick another page and the widget goes there straight away.
The Custom widget counts its services right: 41, in five groups.
Unticking a box in the Notes widget right after ticking it is saved.
Retry on a stopped feed answers straight away instead of fetching every feed first.
With animations off or less motion, the pages and recent panels open in the middle again instead of off the right edge.
A spread category keeps its names as wide as it had them in one column.
A tablet shows the time once in the header, not twice.
Re-check on the selection bar says how many were really checked, and tries the ones that hit a limit again.
Unsorted is called Unsorted when you group by page, not 999999.
A shared page template keeps long names whole instead of cutting a letter in half.
